charts.title: HD 108236 c: orbits around HD 108236
charts.description: The orbits of HD 108236's planets in this map from above, to scale, with HD 108236 c highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Kokori et al. 2023 (2023ApJS..265....4K), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname KOKORI_ET_AL__2023): P 6.203688 d

charts.title: HD 108236 c: its transit
charts.description: HD 108236 c crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (99, 100, 101) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 260647166, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, moved 6 minutes later to where TESS measures the dip, inside the published ephemeris's 3-sigma uncertainty of 23 minutes at these dates, then averaged in 11-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Aligned on TESS's dip, 6 min late; 11-min bins.
The ephemeris's own 1σ there is 8 min.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
